aisatsu.title: Greetings, Pronouns & Cultural Etiquette
aisatsu.subtitle: Master situational greetings (Aisatsu), personal pronouns (私/僕/俺), and honorific suffixes (-san, -sama, -kun, -chan).
aisatsu.pronounsIntroDesc: Unlike English, Japanese has distinct pronouns based on gender, intimacy, and formal context.
aisatsu.honorificsIntroDesc: Used after someone's name to express respect, politeness, or intimacy.
aisatsu.testSubtitle: Test your mastery of Aisatsu greetings, pronouns, and cultural honorifics. (Target: ≥ 85%)

numbers.title: Numbers, Counters & Telling Time
numbers.subtitle: Count 1–10,000, 8 counter units with sound changes, and reading Hours/Minutes/Days.
numbers.quizSubtitle: Test your knowledge of numbers, counting units, dates and times.

radicals.title: 50+ Foundational Pictographic Kanji Radicals
radicals.subtitle: Explore visual radicals, stroke orders, and AI canvas stroke evaluation.

basicGrammar.title: Sentence Structures, Tenses & Starter Graduation
basicGrammar.subtitle: Master core sentence patterns (N1 は N2 です), demonstratives, tense tables, and pass your starter graduation exam!
basicGrammar.tensesTableSubtitle: Compare Present ↔ Past between Nouns (`desu`) and Verbs (`masu`).
basicGrammar.realEx1: • 昨日は 雨でした (Yesterday it was raining — Past tense of Noun).
basicGrammar.realEx2: • きのう 勉強しました (Yesterday I studied — Past tense of Verb ます ➔ ました).
